decisions.reason: Shows both patches insert the same id/name, traces the throw to EntryGroup.update during cordis:include application, explains why duplicate insertion is fatal rather than merged, and rejects the profile comment's harmless-redundancy premise.

Fully distinguishes config override by id (safe), inserting a new id (safe), and inserting a bundle-shipped id (fatal), classifies the maintainer's row as case (c), and grounds each in the excerpts and sibling rows.

One deletion of the redundant profile block, preserving the bundle row and all unrelated plugins/config, with explicit rejection of renaming, deleting the bundle service, or adding another insert; config tuning via id override.

Explains the crash occurs in composition before any plugin module is imported, so no plugin-side change can resolve it; states the deletion restores boot only and keeps the original read failure as a separate, to-be-verified problem.

Requires grepping the installed web-app bundle's (and other composing bundles') cordis.patch.yml for the id and distinguishing override from insert before adding rows; proposes a concrete host diagnostic naming workspace-files, both file origins with line locators, and the delete-the-profile-block remedy.

caps.reason: The affirmative fix removes the duplicate; duplicate-id tolerance is discussed only as something the loader must not silently do.
